# Startup Jury AI
> AI-powered startup idea validation platform. 8 expert AI personas debate startup ideas and deliver GO/MAYBE/NO-GO verdicts in under 5 minutes.

## What We Do
Startup Jury AI simulates an expert investment panel debate using 8 distinct AI personas — angel investors, venture capitalists, operators, and skeptics. Founders describe their startup idea in plain language, and the AI jury debates it across 4 progressive rounds using weighted scoring criteria including TAM, team grit, market timing, and execution risk.

## Key Facts
- 2,400+ startup ideas evaluated
- 8 AI judge personas with unique scoring criteria
- 4 debate rounds with progressively shorter responses
- Verdicts: GO (high potential), MAYBE (needs work), NO-GO (high risk)
- Results delivered in under 5 minutes
- No pitch deck required
- Freemium: 2 free evaluations, $8.99/month unlimited
